text: 1. Non-Chinese citizens, in good health. 2. Possess a high school diploma or equivalent educational qualification, and be between 18 and 24 years old. 3. Applicants for courses taught in Chinese must achieve a score of at least 180 on the New Chinese Proficiency Test (HSK Level 4). Applicants for courses taught in English must have an English proficiency score of 5.5 or above on the IELTS, or 69 or above on the TOEFL, or 90 or above on the PTE, or provide proof of English instruction for their highest degree (with the school's official seal).
